name: Piloos Doc
description: Read and edit Word (.docx) files on your phone or computer: headings, lists, fonts and sizes, tables, pictures, shapes, equations, columns, section breaks, headers and footers, page numbers, comments and footnotes, track changes, page view and PDF export. Opens files straight from other apps, keeps a draft of your edits, and works offline.

workflowSuggestions.title: Soạn thảo Word
workflowSuggestions.prompt: Mở Piloos Doc và giúp tôi mở một file Word.
